name: AUT_ONC_EXP_REQCOUNT
description: The AUT_ONC_EXP_REQCOUNT table contains data about requested counts defaulting from treatment plans. The items here are stamps and live items to compare what the system thinks the value should be versus what users have inputted.

columns.name: AUTH_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the authorization record.

columns.name: NUM_SVCS_APPROVED
columns.description: The number of services or units approved by the payor.

columns.name: NUM_SVCS_REQUESTED
columns.description: The number of services or units requested.

columns.name: COVERAGE_ID
columns.description: The coverage associated with the authorization.
